# Rust crates in the Mermaid import

Linked statically into Animated Diagrams through merman (`third_party/merman`, `WITH_MERMAID`).
Sources: https://crates.io (exact versions in `Cargo.lock`). The MPL-2.0 crates (cssparser, selectors,
dtoa-short) are used unmodified; their source code is available at the repositories below.

Generated by `list_crates.py`.
